text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш has won many G1 races, and
the
autumn Tenno Sho is particularly
fresh in her
memory.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
When I tell her how radiant she looked
that day,
kneeling on the track after
winning before her
parents, she smiles
bashfully.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
